name: kids-go
description: Kids Igo — children's Go learning game (Cloudflare Free)

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply kids-go --local --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p workers/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/go-engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:engine && npm run test:security && npm run build:web
